story:
At a wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water into wine, His first miracle (John 2:1-11). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory verse: "Do whatever He tells you" (John 2:5)
Memory line: Do whatever Jesus says!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What did the servants fill the jars with? (Water!)
Ages 4-8: What did Mary tell the servants? Why did the servants know the miracle was real? How can we do what Jesus says today?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for Jesus. Help us trust Him and do what He says. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Fill clear cups with water, add a drop of red juice, and remember how Jesus changed the water at the wedding.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
A wedding day in Cana town
Music playing, dancing around
But oh no, the wine ran out
Mary knew just what to do

[Chorus]
Do whatever He says, do whatever He says
Jesus knows the very best way
Fill the jars up to the top
Do whatever He says!

[Verse 2]
Six big jars, the servants came
Filled them up with water again
Jesus spoke and it was changed
Now the wine was sweet and rich

[Chorus]
Do whatever He says, do whatever He says
Jesus knows the very best way
Fill the jars up to the top
Do whatever He says!

[Verse 3]
The best was saved until the end
Jesus is our kindest friend
Trust Him in the little things
Joy and love is what He brings

[Chorus - lifted]
Do whatever He says, do whatever He says
Jesus knows the very best way
Fill the jars up to the top
Do whatever He says!

[Outro]
Do whatever He says!
Jesus knows!

#EliorasBibleStories #BibleForKids #KidsSongs #Jesus
